name: vanta-erp-monorepo
description: VANTA ERP - Operations Intelligence Platform (Mini ERP + CRM)

scripts.build: npm run build --workspaces --if-present && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(fs.existsSync('apps/web/dist')){fs.cpSync('apps/web/dist', 'dist', {recursive:true}); fs.cpSync('apps/web/dist', 'public', {recursive:true});}"
scripts.vercel-build: npm run build --workspace=@vanta/shared && npm run build --workspace=@vanta/web && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.cpSync('apps/web/dist', 'dist', {recursive:true}); fs.cpSync('apps/web/dist', 'public', {recursive:true});"

author: VANTA Operations Engineering
